title: Software analysis
description: Binaries in a read-only folder, the agent reaches only its provider; capa, FLOSS, radare2, YARA and binwalk as MCP servers in containers of their own.

de.title: Software-Analyse
de.description: Binärdateien in einem nur lesbaren Ordner, der Agent erreicht nur seinen Anbieter; capa, FLOSS, radare2, YARA und binwalk als MCP-Server in eigenen Containern.

prompt: Analyse the samples in /mnt/samples: what each one is, what it can do (capa), its strings (FLOSS), its structure (radare2), YARA matches. Never run a sample. Write one report per sample to /work/reports/.
notes: Samples stay read-only and the agent reaches only its provider: nothing it finds can call home.
